fields.label: Country
fields.note: ASP.NET select; option values are ISO3 codes (India=IND). Selecting a country postbacks to populate state.

fields.label: City
fields.note: ASP.NET select populated by country/state postbacks (ddlState then ddlCity); no fixed options until a country is chosen.

fields.label: Experience (years)
fields.note: Minimum and maximum experience selects; options are 1-14 and both form fields are submitted together (ddlMinExp, ddlTotExpYears).

notes: Server-rendered ASP.NET WebForms portal. The IT opportunities page posts back to itself (CurrentOpportunity.aspx) with __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION plus the free-text field txtAdvanceSearch (placeholder 'Enter keyword like (Job Reference ID or Job Title or Skills or Experience)') and optional ddlCountry/ddlState/ddlCity/ddlMinExp/ddlTotExpYears. BPS opportunities live on BpsOpportunity.aspx. The adapter uses the unfiltered free-text search (empty keyword) as the complete membership; no JSON search API exists.
evidence: rendered form inputs: ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$txtAdvanceSearch, ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$ddlCountry (ISO3 values), ddlState, ddlCity, ddlMinExp, ddlTotExpYears
